1.0.0: Receive Hub: webhook trigger that fires when the selected hub sends data to the flow. HubBI resolves the webhook URL of the flow itself, so nothing has to be configured beyond the hub. Records are emitted one at a time by default, or all at once as a single list; in both modes the hub's target fields are exposed on the output port. An event carrying no records is acknowledged without triggering the flow. A flow refuses to start when a Start Hub or Start Hub With Data in it uses the same hub, which would make the flow trigger itself.
Start Hub: start a hub that does not take any data.

Start Hub With Data: start a hub with one or more records, built from the hub's source field definitions and sent in a single bulk request. .NET field types (Int32, Int64, Double, Decimal, DateTime, Date, Guid, Boolean, ...) are mapped to matching inspector input types and JSON schema types.

The hub picker offers only the hubs of the connected HubBI client and takes no mapped values, so a hub is always an explicit choice. Each action reads its hubs from the list that fits it: target hubs for Receive Hub, source hubs with or without post data for the two Start Hub actions.
HTTP 409 (Conflict) is treated as transient and retried, while HTTP 423 (Locked) is not retried. All other errors keep the retry engine's default classification.
Flow Test Mode: Receive Hub synthesizes a representative event from the selected hub's target field definitions, since HubBI exposes no endpoint for reading past events.
